summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Watchlist persistence  ### What I found from a read-only audit I checked the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → schema → `db/auth.ts` / `modules/auth/handlers.ts`.  Contrary to the ticket's working theory, the obvious suspects are all clean: - No localStorage/sessionStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist code (`WatchlistPage.tsx` fetches fresh from the API on every mount). - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so the session cookie is always attached. - GET/POST/DELETE
